question: Charminar, a popular monument and mosque, is located in:
solution:
The correct answer is __Hyderabad__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Charminar is located in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. 

 
 
• It was constructed in 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah.
 
• It is a monument and mosque. Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah built it in 1591 after shifting his capital from Golkonda to the city of Hyderabad. 
 
• It has become a symbol of Hyderabad.
 
• It is listed as an archaeological and architectural treasure on the official "List of Monuments" prepared by the Archaeological Survey of India.
 
• It has been officially incorporated as the Emblem of Telangana for the state of Telangana.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hyderabad: 

 
 
• Hyderabad is the capital city of the Indian state of Telangana and the de jure capital of Andhra Pradesh. 
 
• According to the 2011 Census of India, Hyderabad is the fourth-most populous city in India. 
 
• Hyderabad was integrated into the Indian Union in 1948 and continued as the capital of Hyderabad State (1948–56).
 
• In 2014, Andhra Pradesh was bifurcated to form Telangana and Hyderabad became the joint capital of the two states with a transitional arrangement scheduled to end in 2024.
